context.target_user: Solo practitioners, healthcare clinic owners, and small business operators
context.problem: Synthesizing disorganized clinic protocols, pricing schedules, and practice notes into structured research summaries without factual drift.
context.use_case: Private source-grounded knowledge querying and citation mapping from internal business documentation.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 01, NotebookLM grounded 100% of factual synthesis in uploaded clinic sources with paragraph citation chips, correctly identifying omitted modalities without hallucinating. Recommending is conditioned upon practitioner curation of source notes.
when_to_consider: When synthesizing messy internal clinic notes, PDFs, and treatment guidelines into grounded brief material.
When zero-hallucination factual containment is strictly required.
When looking for a free, secure source-grounding repository prior to drafting.
when_not_to_use: When expecting live web crawling or automated competitive search intelligence.
When source documents have not been reviewed for factual accuracy and completeness.
